Definition: from the base of G5088; a child (as produced):--child, daughter, son.
BiblicalUsage: The word is children, sons and daughters. John says, Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God, and, Beloved, now are we the sons of God. Paul says to be followers of God, as dear children, and to Timothy, my own son in the faith, and to the Galatians, My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe children of God is the greatest name in the Bible, and it is given, not earned. My position is that the Father's love makes sons of strangers, and the child who is His will grow into Christ's likeness.
